activity.role: Co-President of the French Committee of National Liberation
activity.notes: Joint CFLN copresidency with Charles de Gaulle from 3 June 1943. De Gaulle Foundation dates loss of copresidency to Oct 2; French armed forces official narrative dates formal removal from committee to Nov 9. End listed Oct 2 as approximate de facto co-chair authority, NOT falsely equating it to membership removal on Nov 9 or an independent French presidency. Context CFLN already registered in France Republic polity, reuse it without new sovereign Free France state.

sources.title: Fondation Charles de Gaulle — Henri GIRAUD
sources.citation_text: Giraud Third Army 1936, Seventh Army 1939, Ninth Army after 15 May 1940, prisoner on May 18, North Africa civil-military command late 1942, CFLN copresidency 3 June to early Oct 1943, general commander in chief ending 4 April 1944, Superior War Council 1949.

sources.title: Fondation Charles de Gaulle — Historical chronology of CFLN
sources.citation_text: Timeline confirms CFLN June 3 1943 creation and Giraud displaced from copresidency October 2 1943.

sources.title: Ministère des Armées — Création et action du CFLN
sources.citation_text: CFLN formed 3 June 1943; co-presidency duties eroded by early August and Giraud removed from the Committee 9 November 1943. This committee-membership end differs from earlier de facto political copresidency end.
